title: MetaGRADE: pairwise and network meta-analysis with GRADE certainty of evidence (Core GRADE and GRADE for NMA)
description: Browser-based tool for pairwise and network meta-analysis with suggested certainty-of-evidence ratings following Core GRADE and the GRADE approach for network meta-analysis (stepwise direct, indirect and network ratings), summary of findings tables with colour legend, supplementary GRADE tables, funnel plots, node-splitting and Evidence-to-Decision frameworks. All calculations run in the browser.
